t_advice_summary_textbox.text: you will encounter a pair of gnomes, one gnome leads to the forest with a yellow basket, and one leads with a red basket. certain gnomes lead to the red basket. the basket colour might change between giving lots of mushrooms and giving less. it is important to try to pay attention to the number of mushrooms collected before the multiplier rather than the total score collected in the forest. after you collect the mushrooms it displays your total score the type of mushrooms might be between 0-9. try to memorise which gnomes lead to the forest.

vb_textbox.text: You will be presented with a pair of gnomes, one gnome will take you to a forest with a yellow basket the other gnome will take you to a forest with a red basket. The advice I was given suggested that the tall brown, and blue gnomes and the short orange gnome and short green gnomes lead to the red basket. I found this to be true. For me it seemed like the red basket issued more mushrooms more frequently, but this will switch around regularly.
